deploy_posture: PRODUCTION-IMPACTING (Render redeploys backend with corrected middleware ordering — webhook routes now bypass global express.json() and use express.raw() for raw body access). NO migration. NO schema change. NO behaviour change for any non-webhook route.
fix: Carved defect — the A6.5 webhook flow's hand-rolled captureRawBody middleware in webhook.routes.js conflicted with the global express.json() in app.js. Body stream was already drained by json() before captureRawBody attached its listeners → req.on('end') never fired → handler hung → no response → Razorpay timeouts. Fix: conditionally bypass express.json() for /v1/webhooks/* paths in app.js + use Express's built-in express.raw() in webhook.routes.js + read Buffer body in webhook.controller.js. Canonical webhook pattern.
result: app.js wraps express.json() with conditional skip for /v1/webhooks/*; webhook.routes.js now uses express.raw({type:'*/*',limit:'5mb'}); webhook.controller.handleWebhook reads req.body as Buffer + JSON.parse on utf8 string. Backend boot smoke clean. pnpm qa 76/76 GREEN STATE=GREEN gate=0 (47.0s). Ready to push.
regression_proof: pnpm qa 76/76 GREEN STATE=GREEN gate=0. Non-webhook routes still get express.json({limit:'5mb'}) identically via the conditional wrapper falling through. Webhook routes (/v1/webhooks/*) get express.raw() as the canonical body capture. Signature verification reads Buffer; event payload parses via JSON.parse(Buffer.toString('utf8')). Zero behaviour change for any non-webhook endpoint; full webhook-handler activation for /v1/webhooks/razorpay.
discipline: Verify-twice on app.js confirmed express.json() is unconditionally mounted globally at line 53 BEFORE any route is matched (line 101).
